act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 23 (Delhi) + Delhi Dept. of Revenue operative rate
source.quoted_text: Delhi Dept. of Revenue (official) — Sale Deed: 'Stamp & Transfer Duty @ 4% if the vendee is a woman and @ 6% if the vendee is a man'. Schedule I-A Art. 23 (Conveyance): '5% of the consideration amount set forth in the instrument', with note 'Further reduced from 5% to 3% in respect of conveyance, sale and Agreement to sale in cases of the purchase of immovable property by women, either individually or severally.' Operative combined stamp+transfer duty as published by the Department of Revenue: 6% (male vendee) / 4% (female vendee) / 5% (joint male+female). Base = higher of consideration or circle-rate (market value); the user supplies market value (circle-rate DB is out of scope, PRD §3).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH for the operative total (official Delhi Dept. of Revenue). Rate = 6% male / 4% female / 5% joint on higher-of(consideration, market value). COMPOSITION (reviewer info): this operative rate = Schedule I-A stamp duty (5% general / 3% women / 4% joint) + MCD transfer duty (~1%); encoded here as the combined operative figure to match the official published number the buyer pays. OPEN QUESTIONS FOR FOUNDER: (1) confirm exact effective_from — the underlying women-concession & transfer-duty notification dates (needed for historical mode, M2); set 2020-01-01 as a conservative current-law floor. (2) Confirm whether to split stamp vs transfer duty as separate breakup lines (and the exact transfer-duty rate/threshold, some sources cite 1% above Rs 25 lakh). (3) Confirm the Delhi rounding rule for stamp duty (encoded as none pending confirmation). (4) 'joint' assumes one male + one female co-vendee; confirm multi-owner / primary-holder logic.
